title: BillOfLading
description:
A bill of lading: a document issued by a carrier evidencing a transport
contract and the receipt of goods for shipment. First version, aligned to
the UNVTD bill of lading credential subject
(https://unvtd.unece.org/bill-of-lading-schema.yaml)

billOfLadingNumber.description:
Reference number to identify a document evidencing a transport contract.
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/identifier

documentIdentifier.description: Reference number identifying a specific document.

bookingReferenceNumber.description:
Reference number assigned by a carrier to identify a specific
consignment.

issueDate.description: Date that a document was issued.

consignmentLoadingDate.description: Date when a consignment is loaded onto a means of transport.

estimatedTimeOfDeparture.description: Date and time when a transport means is scheduled to depart.

estimatedTimeOfArrival.description: Date and time of the estimated arrival of means of transport.

consignor.description:
Party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract.
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/consignorParty

consignee.description:
Party to which goods are consigned.
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/consigneeParty

carrier.description:
Party providing the transport of goods between named points.
x-json-ld-property: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/carrierParty

freightPayer.description: Party responsible for the payment of freight charges.

originalLoadingLocation.description: Location where the goods were first loaded onto the means of transport.

baseportUnloadingLocation.description: The place or port at which the cargo is discharged.

deliveryLocation.description:
Location to which a consignment is to be delivered to the final
consignee.

placeOfDeparture.description: Port from which a means of transport is scheduled to depart.

arrivalLocation.description: Port at which a means of transport is scheduled to arrive.

paymentLocation.description: Place where the payment has been or should be made.

placeOfIssue.description: Location where a document was issued.

conveyanceReferenceNumber.description:
Identifier of a journey of a means of transport, for example voyage
number.

transportMeansIdentifier.description: Name of a specific means of transport such as the vessel name.

transportMeansRegistration.description: Identifier of a specific means of transport.

containerSizeAndType.description:
Code specifying the characteristics, i.e. size and type of a piece of
transport equipment.

fullOrEmptyContainer.description: Code specifying how full a piece of transport equipment is (5=Full).

transportEquipmentIdentifier.description: Identifier of a piece of transport equipment e.g. container.

sealIdentifier.description:
The identification number of a seal affixed to a piece of transport
equipment.

descriptionOfGoods.description: Plain language description of the nature of a goods item.

consignmentSummaryDescription.description: Plain language description of a consignment in summary terms.

shippingMarks.description:
Free form description of the marks and numbers on a transport unit or
package.

transportContractConditions.description: Reference to carrier's conditions of carriage.

prepaidAmount.description: Monetary amount of charges which have been paid in advance.

collectCharges.description: Monetary amount of charges to be collected from the consignee.

contractNumber.description: Identifier of a contract concluded between parties.

ucr.description: Unique Consignment Reference identifying a particular consignment.

goods.description: Goods covered by the bill of lading
